result.topic_en: Draft of Riemann's air-wave paper: introducing p and q as independent variables to make the equations of motion linear, showing that (x-(u+a)t)dp + (x-(u-a)t)dq is an exact differential dw, and treating the exceptional cases where the Jacobian vanishes (simple waves).

methods.what: Hodograph-type transformation: taking p and q (Riemann invariants) as independent variables instead of x and t makes the equations linear
methods.quote: sie gehen aber in lineare über, [-... ... ...-] wenn man p und q für x und t als unabhängig veränderliche einführt.

methods.what: Existence of a potential w whose differential is (x-(u+a)t)dp + (x-(u-a)t)dq, giving a linear second-order PDE for w

methods.quote: $-2at = \frac{\partial^2 w}{\partial p\,\partial q} = \frac{\partial w}{\partial p} - \frac{\partial w}{\partial q}$
